card.name: Linking words before water or fluid terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, than, and, for, a comma) where the next word could plausibly be 'water' or a fluid term. Seen in all-caps label text on sodium, fluid and hydration, and in odd archaic prose.

modes.description: Small words or a comma in all-caps warnings about sodium, fluid, dehydration or saline, just before a likely fluid word.
